2608.10665.title: VERDICT: Training-Free Step-Wise Verification of Multimodal Reasoning via Disagreement-Aware Consensus
2608.10665.paper_summary: Multimodal large language models often generate reasoning chains containing subtle errors that lead to incorrect answers. Current verification approaches have notable limitations. Existing approaches either require expensive labelled supervision with inconsistent cross-task performance or aggregate scores from multiple sources by simple aggregations, missing a key insight: when these scores disagree, that disagreement itself carries important information about whether a reasoning step is truly valid or not. We formalise this as a coupled scoring problem among disparate, frozen verifiers, interpretable as a coordination game with a unique closed-form equilibrium where agreement signals valid steps while disagreement reveals instability. Towards this end, we propose a training-free domain-agnostic step-wise verification approach we call VERDICT: VERification via Disagreement-Informed Coupled Thresholding. To our knowledge, VERDICT is the first training-free verifier that makes the structure of cross-modal disagreement explicit and actionable. It computes consensus scores through a closed-form solution, enabling both disagreement-aware filtering and stability-conscious ranking of reasoning steps. Evaluated across six benchmarks, \method consistently improves over the base model by up to +5.95%, and performs competitively with domain-specific critics that demand extensive supervision, demonstrating that cross-modal agreement provides robust verification signals without task-specific adaptation and Training-Free Verification
2608.10665.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型經常生成包含微妙錯誤的推理鏈，導致錯誤的答案。當前的驗證方法存在顯著的限制。現有的方法要麼需要昂貴的標註監督，且在不同任務間表現不一致，要麼通過簡單的聚合從多個來源匯總分數，錯過了一個關鍵的洞察：當這些分數不一致時，這種不一致本身攜帶著重要的信息，關於某個推理步驟是否真正有效。我們將此形式化為一個在不同、固定的驗證者之間的耦合評分問題，可以解釋為一種協調遊戲，具有獨特的封閉形式均衡，其中一致性信號代表有效步驟，而不一致則揭示不穩定性。為此，我們提出了一種無需訓練的領域無關的逐步驗證方法，我們稱之為VERDICT：通過不一致知情的耦合閾值進行驗證。據我們所知，VERDICT是第一個使跨模態不一致的結構明確且可操作的無需訓練的驗證器。它通過封閉形式的解計算共識分數，使得不一致感知的過濾和穩定性意識的推理步驟排序成為可能。在六個基準測試中，\method的表現始終超過基礎模型，提升幅度高達+5.95%，並與需要廣泛監督的領域特定評審競爭，證明了跨模態一致性提供了穩健的驗證信號，而無需特定任務的適應和無需訓練的驗證。
